ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
title: Third Preparatory Meeting of BRICS Women's Working Group convened by the Ministry of Women and Child Development
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Women and Child Development

Third Preparatory Meeting of BRICS Women's Working Group convened by the Ministry of Women and Child Development

BRICS Member Countries hold discussions on strengthening collaboration and building consensus ahead of the BRICS Women Track Meetings in Kochi, Kerala from 6-9 July 2026

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
29 JUN 2026 9:53PM by PIB Delhi

The Ministry of Women and Child Development convened the Third Preparatory Meeting of the BRICS Women Track under India's BRICS Chairship in virtual mode on 29th June 2026 under the theme
Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability
. The meeting was chaired by Shri Anil Malik, Secretary, Ministry of Women and Child Development, who underscored the significance of the meeting in preparing for the BRICS Women Working Group Meeting and the BRICS Women Ministerial Meeting to be held in Kochi, Kerala, from 6-9 July 2026.

The meeting focused on advancing discussions on the priority areas and key outcomes, including the
Digital Repository of Best Practices
 and the
BRICS Women’s

Capacity Building Guidelines
. BRICS Member Countries shared their valuable inputs and reaffirmed their commitment to collaborative and consensus-based outcomes.

Congratulating India on its BRICS Chairship, Member Countries appreciated the progress made under the Women Track and expressed their continued support for strengthening cooperation on women's empowerment.

The Chair thanked all participating delegations for their constructive contributions and reiterated India's commitment to fostering practical partnerships that promote women-led development across BRICS nations.
